description:
Search 1stDibs items by keyword, optionally narrowed by filters. Use it when
        the user describes what they want in words. Returns 20 items per page
        with price, availability, photos, and product page links; descriptions are shortened.
        Pass nextPage as page for more. Filters are a query string like
        category=furniture&location=usa-north-america; get them from read_taxonomy.

filters.description: Filters from read_taxonomy as a query string, such as "category=furniture&location=usa-north-america"

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Use nextPage from the previous result.

query.description: Search terms, such as "mid-century walnut credenza"

name: search_items
title: Search 1stDibs Items
